stem_book: A cart is moving horizontally along a straight line with constant speed 30 m/s. A projectile is to be fired from the moving cart in such a way that it will return to the cart after the cart has moved 80 m. At what speed (relative to the cart) must the projectile be fired? (Take g = 10 m/s²) (a) 10 m/s (b) 10√8 m/s (c) 40/3 m/s (d) none
work: T = 80/30 = 8/3 s; must be fired vertically relative to cart ⇒ u = gT/2 = 10·(4/3) = 40/3 m/s
